prior: IC11 operator audit returns aggregates but invokes _child_directory for read path, which performs os.mkdir when shard absent, so alleged read-only audit might mutate storage.
H1: An audit of a manifest referencing missing object/shard creates empty shard; replace with strictly existing-only nofollow fd traversal, report MISSING_OR_UNSAFE_OBJECT without mutation.
H0: No mutation occurs despite _child_directory's documented mkdir path.
tests: malformed manifest referring to valid hash with absent shard must not create shard on disk
empty root without objects must remain unchanged after audit
regular valid fake object remains VALID_OBJECT
acceptance: A purely read-only operator audit function on POSIX with regression test and no source-content leakage.
